title: Area-code shard C pass 21 — 608 / 617 / 620

data.research_question: Which current public organizations, public organizational actors, affiliations and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 608, 617, and 620?
data.method: Current NANPA membership and deterministic NPA mod 3 == 2 selection; literal and locality-derived public web searches; first-party/current-status verification; historical-directory leads treated only as seeds; repository dedupe; public-person cross-enumeration.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational participation, public representation, attendance, residence or volunteering.
Do not merge organizations or people from similar names or handles alone.
Directly stated and inferred person-org relations must remain distinguishable; this pass retained only directly stated person-org relations.
Area-code locality association is not a claim that an organization publishes a telephone number in that NPA unless separately evidenced.

findings.notes: Existing canonical Madison Food Not Bombs and Madison MAN Cooperative identities/targets reused. Madison MAN has current September 2026 activity and public email; Stephanie Rearick is directly identified as its founder. Madison FNB remains anarchist-associated Food Not Bombs; no stable named current representative was found in this bounded pass.

Existing canonical Boston Food Not Bombs identity/target reused; current first-party site confirms weekly non-hierarchical operations and public Roxbury email/Instagram. Lucy Parsons Center newly materialized as a current collectively run radical bookstore/community space; historical predecessor was run in anarchist milieus, but current org is not relabeled anarchist. George Katsiaficas is retained only in the directly stated historical predecessor-cofounder role.

Hutch in Harmony and Just-As-You-Are Rainbow Sanctuary retained as current Hutchinson/Emporia community and mutual-aid organizations. Current first-party staff page names three Hutch in Harmony directors; local reporting identifies Skye Baxter as Rainbow Sanctuary founder. Neither organization is relabeled anarchist.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 608, 617, and 620.
